tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Window and page background. Every text color below is measured on it.

tokens.name: panel
tokens.usage: Sidebars and side panels.

tokens.name: popover
tokens.usage: Menus and popovers.

tokens.name: fg
tokens.usage: Text and icons on bg, panel and popover. 16.4:1 on bg in light, 14.0:1 in dark.

tokens.name: fg-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: descriptions, captions, inactive tabs. 5.8:1 on bg in light. 4.4:1 in dark, just under 4.5:1: flagged, not changed by this draft.

tokens.name: fg-faint
tokens.usage: Placeholders and disabled text only. 3.1:1 in light, 2.0:1 in dark, so never for text people must read.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Muted labels (data-muted) and sidebar headings. 5.9:1 on bg in both themes.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Selection, focus rings, links and accent fills. As text on bg: 4.4:1 in light (just under 4.5:1), 5.8:1 in dark.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on accent fills. 3.8:1 in light, under 4.5:1 for 13px labels: flagged. 6.8:1 in dark.

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: Fill of prominent controls: primary buttons, switches that are on. Follows fg.

tokens.name: control
tokens.usage: Controls at rest: switch and slider tracks, tiles.

tokens.name: knob
tokens.usage: Switch and slider knobs, on control or primary.

tokens.name: thumb
tokens.usage: Scrollbar thumbs.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Edges of cards and fields when the theme draws outlines.

tokens.name: divider
tokens.usage: Separators, rules between rows, the bottom edge of bars.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: The dimmed layer behind dialogs and sheets.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Success states, always with an icon or a word. As text on bg: 4.3:1 in light (under 4.5:1), 7.5:1 in dark.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Warnings, always with an icon or a word. 4.6:1 on bg in light, 8.4:1 in dark.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Errors and destructive actions, always with an icon or a word. 4.9:1 on bg in light, 5.3:1 in dark.

tokens.name: redline-gap
tokens.usage: Spec overlays only: marks a gap that a parent layout owns. Not part of the product palette.

tokens.name: redline-inset
tokens.usage: Spec overlays only: marks the inset between a container's edge and its content. Not part of the product palette.

styles.name: micro
styles.usage: Badges and keycaps in small text.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Extra-small controls, chips, hints under fields.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Split the pane to the right
styles.usage: Controls, rows and interface text. The root style: text with no style of its own gets this one.

styles.name: lead
styles.sample: Pick a theme for every window

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: Headings of panes, cards and dialogs.

styles.name: read-h1
styles.usage: Document titles. Today 28px on a 45.5px line.

styles.name: read-h2
styles.usage: Document sections. Today 21px on a 34px line.

styles.name: read-h4
styles.usage: Minor headings, same size as the text. Today 15.75px on a 25.5px line.

styles.name: read-body
styles.sample: A pressable control drawn by ala and by the browser from the same tokens.
styles.usage: Paragraphs, lists and quotes in documents and chat. Unchanged.

styles.name: read-small
styles.usage: Figure captions, table cells and footnotes in documents.

styles.name: touch-small
styles.usage: Secondary text in compact and touch layouts.

styles.name: touch-body
styles.usage: Rows and controls in compact and touch layouts.

styles.name: touch-title
styles.usage: Large titles in compact layouts. Today 34px on a 41px line.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Code in the interface. Mono is a family, not a size: code inside reading text takes read-body's size and line.

tokens.name: space-0
tokens.usage: No space: rows that touch.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Inside controls only: segment padding, offsets within a badge.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: gap-tight and inset-row. Icon gap in small controls.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Inside controls only: icon gap in medium controls, field inset in small ones, inset-chrome.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: gap-related. The most used length in penna today: 121 of 434 spacing values.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Inside controls only: chip inset, large field inset.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Medium control inset and inset-card.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: gap-group and inset-pane. Large control inset. Touch insets of 20px fold here or to 24.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Dialog inset; page inset on narrow windows.

tokens.name: space-32
tokens.usage: gap-section and inset-page.

tokens.name: space-40
tokens.usage: Page inset of documents on wide windows.

tokens.name: space-64
tokens.usage: The largest step: the top of a document hero. The docs site's 96px folds here.

tokens.name: gap-tight
tokens.usage: Between a label and the thing it names: a title and its description, a field label and its field. Equals space-4.

tokens.name: gap-related
tokens.usage: Between siblings that work together: buttons in a bar, chips, fields in one row. Equals space-8.

tokens.name: gap-group
tokens.usage: Between groups inside a pane: form groups, cards in a column. Equals space-16.

tokens.name: gap-section
tokens.usage: Between sections of a page. Equals space-32.

tokens.name: inset-row
tokens.usage: How far rows sit inside their list, so a selected row never touches the edge. A theme knob (row_inset); 5px in the default theme today.

tokens.name: inset-chrome
tokens.usage: Space above and below the controls of a bar or pane header: a bar is its control height plus twice this.

tokens.name: inset-card
tokens.usage: Content inside cards, menus and popovers.

tokens.name: inset-pane
tokens.usage: Content inside panes and dialogs.

tokens.name: inset-page
tokens.usage: Content of document pages, like the docs site.

size.note: Heights of controls, rows and bars, and the widths that frame text. Every height is a step of this ladder.

tokens.name: control-xs
tokens.usage: Extra-small controls: chips in dense rows. Text: caption. Inset 8px.

tokens.name: control-sm
tokens.usage: Small controls. Text: small. Inset 8px, icon 12px, icon gap 4px. The default control in the compact density.

tokens.name: control-md
tokens.usage: Default controls: buttons, fields, selects, segmented controls. Text: body. Inset 12px, icon 14px, icon gap 6px.

tokens.name: control-lg
tokens.usage: Large controls; the default in the comfortable density. Text: body. Inset 16px, icon 16px, icon gap 6px.

tokens.name: control-xl
tokens.usage: Prominent actions and two-line rows. Text: lead. Inset 16px, icon 16px, icon gap 8px.

tokens.name: touch
tokens.usage: The smallest touch target in compact and touch layouts.

tokens.name: row
tokens.usage: List, sidebar and menu rows. Follows the density like control-md.

tokens.name: control-chrome
tokens.usage: Controls inside bars and pane headers: icon buttons, window tabs. Today PANE_HEADER_CONTROL_HEIGHT.

tokens.name: bar
tokens.usage: Title bar and pane headers: control-chrome plus inset-chrome above and below (22 + 6 + 6).

tokens.name: icon-sm
tokens.usage: Icons beside small and caption text.

tokens.name: icon-md
tokens.usage: Icons beside body text.

tokens.name: icon-lg
tokens.usage: Icons beside lead and heading text.

tokens.name: measure
tokens.usage: Widest line of reading text: about 75 characters of read-body.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Square edges: window controls on Windows and Linux, flush panes.

tokens.name: radius-theme
tokens.usage: The theme's corner knob: windows, panes and cards. 24px in the default and macOS themes, 16px in Yaru; people can change it in Appearance.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Pills and round knobs. A control never rounds past corner-fraction of its height, so this only applies when the theme asks for pills.

tokens.name: corner-fraction
tokens.usage: A control's radius is the theme radius, capped at 45% of its height: 12.6px on a 28px control.

tokens.name: shadow-contact
tokens.usage: Controls that sit on a surface: buttons, fields, knobs.

tokens.name: shadow-lifted
tokens.usage: Cards and tiles that lift on hover or while dragged.

tokens.name: shadow-float
tokens.usage: Menus, popovers, dialogs and the window frame.
